original_ai_output.title_zh: 天主教教区呼吁停止纳凯凯金矿暴力并展开调查
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹东赤道州卡波埃塔纳凯凯金矿点发生暴力事件，据报出现人员死亡、受伤和紧张局势升级。托里特天主教教区发表声明，呼吁立即停止敌对行动并对暴力事件进行公正调查。声明未说明伤亡人数、责任方或冲突起因，目前仅有单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Nakeke gold mining site in Kapoeta, Eastern Equatoria State

key_facts.fact: 托里特天主教教区呼吁立即停止敌对行动并展开公正调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Catholic Diocese of Torit has called for an immediate end to hostilities and impartial investigations into violence at the Nakeke gold mining site

key_facts.fact: 暴力事件据报造成人员死亡、受伤及紧张局势升级
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: following reports of deaths, injuries and rising tensions

key_facts.fact: 声明未说明死亡或受伤人数、责任方及冲突起因
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The statement did not specify the number of people killed or injured, identify those responsible for the violence, or provide details of the circumstances that triggered the confrontation.

key_facts.fact: 事件发生于东赤道州卡波埃塔的纳凯凯金矿点
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nakeke gold mining site in Kapoeta, Eastern Equatoria State

uncertainties: 暴力事件责任方尚未确定
冲突起因细节未获披露
目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
